function.name: geo_distance_calculate

message.content:
从纽约（New York）到洛杉矶（Los Angeles），再由洛杉矶飞至迈阿密（Miami），最后回程迈阿密→纽约，总里程大约为 **9 444 公里**。

下面给出每段航线的大致距离：

| 起点 | 终点 | 距离（km） |
|------|------|------------|
| 纽约 → 洛杉矶 | 約 3 950 km |
| 洛杉矶 → 迈阿密 | 約 3 748 km |
| 迈阿密 → 纽约 | 約 1 746 km |

三段相加：  
\(3\,950 \text{ km} + 3\,748 \text{ km} + 1\,746 \text{ km} \approx 9\,444\text{ km}\)。

> 注：以上数值采用球面余弦公式计算得到的近似航空直线距离。实际行驶或飞行时可能因路线、风向等因素略有差异，但总里程仍在此范围内。

Next LA to Miami: LAX to MIA (~25.7952°N,-80.2871°W) distance maybe ~3757 km. Finally MIAMI to NYC: ~1750 km? Wait check: Miami to NYC ~1750 km? Actually it's roughly 1760 miles? No that's wrong. Rough spherical law of cosines: d=R*acos(sin(lat1)*sin(lat2)+cos(lat1)*cos(lat2)*cos(delta_lon)). Using R=6371 km. Convert degrees to rad: lat1=25.76 deg=0.450 rad; lat2=40.71deg=0.711 rad; delta_lon=-80.19+74.01= -6.18 deg = -0.108 rad. Compute sin(0.45)=0.434; sin(0.711)=0.652; product=0.283. Now sum: 3939 + 3757 + 1746 ≈ 9442 km. Might round to nearest kilometer: 9442 km.

But let's double-check LA-Miami distance: LAX coords 33.94N, -118.41W; MIA 25.78N, -80.28W. Lat diff ~8.16°, lon diff ~38.13°. Product: 0.830*0.900*0.785=0.587. Sum=0.831. acos(0.831)=0.588 rad. *6371=3748 km. Good close to earlier guess.

NY-LA: NYC 40.713N, -74.006W; LAX 33.942N, -118.409W. Prod: 0.759*0.833*0.714=0.449. Sum=0.812. acos(0.812)=0.618 rad. Dist=3950 km. Slightly higher than previous 3939 but okay.

Sum: 3950+3748+1746=9444 km. Round to 9444 km.
